ConfidenceIntervalV1.description: Two-sided confidence interval with lower bound no greater than upper.
ConfidenceIntervalV1.title: ConfidenceIntervalV1

DataIntegrityRecordV1.description: Observed C5 condition, exact repair, and analysis-input identity.
DataIntegrityRecordV1.title: DataIntegrityRecordV1

metric_id.description: Participant-chosen scientific label for the reported quantity. Diagnostic credit is based on exact value, unit, diagnostic identity, and public-source replay.
metric_id.title: Metric Id

DiagnosticSummaryResultV1.description: A descriptive diagnostic whose finite measure identifiers are unique.
DiagnosticSummaryResultV1.title: DiagnosticSummaryResultV1

DiagnosticTestResultV1.description: A diagnostic test statistic and its reported probability.
DiagnosticTestResultV1.title: DiagnosticTestResultV1

EstimandDeclarationV1.description:
Scientific question targeted by one submitted primary analysis.

Declare exactly one of ``horizon`` and
``horizon_not_applicable_reason``. Intercurrent-event strategy identifiers
must be unique.
EstimandDeclarationV1.title: EstimandDeclarationV1

EstimatorDeclarationV1.description: One complete analysis method selected from the public dictionary.

analysis_method_id.description: Exact method identifier from the participant method dictionary.
analysis_method_id.title: Analysis Method Id

implementation.description: Optional audit note describing the implementation. It does not change method identity or credit.
implementation.title: Implementation

qualifications.description: Optional audit-only assumptions or limitations. Additional qualifications do not alter the selected method; required item evidence must still be supplied as typed evidence records.
qualifications.title: Qualifications

EstimatorDeclarationV1.title: EstimatorDeclarationV1

EvidenceRecordV1.description:
One executed evidence record with fields determined by its evidence type.

Diagnostic and validity records require ``diagnostic_id``, a diagnostic
or factual-premise result, and no estimator. Sensitivity and supporting-analysis records
require an estimator and a non-diagnostic result. Data-quality records use
a non-diagnostic result and no estimator. ``sensitivity_parameter`` is
permitted only for sensitivity records.

diagnostic_id.description: Required only for diagnostic and validity evidence; omit for every other evidence type.
diagnostic_id.title: Diagnostic Id

estimator.description: Required for sensitivity and supporting-analysis evidence; omit for diagnostic, validity, and data-quality evidence.

result.description: Diagnostic and validity evidence require diagnostic_test, diagnostic_summary, or factual_premise; every other evidence type requires a non-diagnostic result shape.
result.title: Result

sensitivity_parameter.description: Optional only for sensitivity evidence; omit for every other evidence type.

EvidenceRecordV1.title: EvidenceRecordV1

FactualPremiseResultV1.description: A conclusion about one premise that is directly stated in a public artifact.
FactualPremiseResultV1.title: FactualPremiseResultV1

IdentifiedIntervalV1.description: An ordered identified interval without a point claim.
IdentifiedIntervalV1.title: IdentifiedIntervalV1

PlanningResultV1.description: Optional event-driven plan with unique sensitivity probabilities.
PlanningResultV1.title: PlanningResultV1

PlanningSensitivityResultV1.description: Sample size under one event-probability sensitivity assumption.
PlanningSensitivityResultV1.title: PlanningSensitivityResultV1

PrimaryAnalysisV1.description: The sole analysis submitted for primary deterministic credit.
PrimaryAnalysisV1.title: PrimaryAnalysisV1

ProbabilityMeasureV1.description: One explicitly rounded probability in the closed unit interval.
ProbabilityMeasureV1.title: ProbabilityMeasureV1

QualifiedNonIdentificationV1.description: A justified conclusion that the requested effect is not identified.
QualifiedNonIdentificationV1.title: QualifiedNonIdentificationV1

ReconstructionSummaryV1.description: Declared analysis-table reconstruction counts and executed checks.
ReconstructionSummaryV1.title: ReconstructionSummaryV1

ScalarEstimateV1.description:
A point estimate contained by its interval on one declared scale.

Hazard-ratio estimates and interval limits must be strictly positive.
ScalarEstimateV1.title: ScalarEstimateV1

TestResultV1.description: A statistical-test result with explicit direction and parameters.
TestResultV1.title: TestResultV1

TimeHorizonV1.description: Assessment horizon for a time-indexed estimand.
TimeHorizonV1.title: TimeHorizonV1

VectorEstimateV1.description: A vector or curve whose point indices are strictly increasing.
VectorEstimateV1.title: VectorEstimateV1

VectorPointV1.description: One coordinate of a vector- or curve-valued estimate.
VectorPointV1.title: VectorPointV1

trialeval.description:
Canonical TrialEval submission with linked analysis references.

Evidence and data-resolution identifiers must be unique, and every
evidence record must be linked once from the primary analysis. A planning
result must target the primary estimand and is valid only for a scalar
log-hazard-ratio primary result.

limitations.description: Optional audit-only free-text limitations. A score-bearing non-identification conclusion belongs in primary_analysis.result as a typed qualified_non_identification result.
limitations.title: Limitations

trialeval.title: TrialEvalSubmissionV1
